comment: The wavetable selector runs along the bottom of the display and is not a parameter, so it carries no help of its own. The menu item reads Retrigger With Phase=0 while the parameter the maker configured for it is named Random Phase on Retrigger; the item name is the one printed on screen and is what the line uses. The retrigger input is read twice over: a rising edge through 1V restarts the oscillator, and its level is also read as a gate that is high above 2V.
